description: PHP class defining the Post model within the Goteo project, including methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting blog post entries, as well as managing their display in different sections such as home and footer. The class interacts with the database, handles localization, and manages associated media and images.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Represents a blog post within the Goteo platform, providing methods for CRUD operations, localization support, media handling, and managing display sections such as home, footer, and node-specific placements.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of database fields that support multiple languages, namely title, subtitle, text, and legend.

methods.name: getBySlug
methods.description: Retrieves a post based on its slug or ID, supporting fallback to ID if slug-based retrieval fails.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a post using its unique ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a post from the database by ID or slug, including related media, images, and author info.

methods.name: getFilteredList
methods.description: Returns a filtered list of posts based on various criteria such as tags, blog, section, author, and publication status.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all posts marked for display in the 'home' or 'footer' sections, optionally filtered by node.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Gets a list of posts to display in portadas (front pages) or footers, filtered by position and node.

methods.name: getSlug
methods.description: Returns the slug of the post, or the ID if the slug is not set.

methods.name: getAutocomplete
methods.description: Provides a list of post IDs and titles for use in autocomplete UI elements.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the post's data, ensuring the title is set.

methods.name: slugExists
methods.description: Checks whether a given slug already exists in the database to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Inserts or updates a post record in the database, handling slug generation and validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates specific fields ('order', 'home', 'footer') of a post in the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a post from a specified display position ('home' or 'footer') by setting its flag to zero.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves a post up in order within a specified section.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves a post down in order within a specified section.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order number for inserting a new post in a section.

methods.name: update_node
methods.description: Updates or inserts a post in a specific node, managing its placement in node-specific front pages.

methods.name: remove_node
methods.description: Removes a post from a specific node.

methods.name: up_node
methods.description: Moves a node-specific post up in its order.

methods.name: down_node
methods.description: Moves a node-specific post down.

methods.name: next_node
methods.description: Calculates the next order number for a post within a node.

methods.name: getListSections
methods.description: Returns the list of available blog sections from configuration.

methods.name: getSection
methods.description: Retrieves the label or description for a specific section.
